replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

You were banned for "Ban Evasion." This means that you were banned on another account and used this account to avoid being banned. You were accused of ban evading as an alt of "Swagmaster_Jacob." Do you have an alibi against this information? If so, please state below.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello Blazing_Creeper,

What is your connection to MaxBlade9 as well? He was deemed to have excessive punishments, and was given a tempban. However, he supposedly evaded, or avoided, his ban by logging onto your account as well as Swagmaster_Jacob. All of your accounts share an IP address, which leads us to believe that these three accounts belong to one person. Despite this, each account by itself has a significant amount of playing time on the server, which suggests that the accounts are not the same person. If you could go in-depth about your connections to the other accounts, you will be considered for an appeal.

Regards,
Qinn | Senior Moderator

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Hello,

It appears that MaxBlade9 was banned for "Excessive Infractions" and was thought to be ban evading through your account. Normally, when a player is caught ban evading, their alt is banned for the same amount of time the main account his. However, the staff member who banned you did not use this code, and permanently banned MaxBlade9, as well as Swagmaster_Jacob and yourself. I will unban all of the accounts, and change the ban time to expire on February 19th, the date at which MaxBlade9's tempban finishes.

Regards,
PeachyYas | Senior Moderator
